Switch tabs and join us for the upcoming match between India U-19 Women and Scotland U-19 Women, scheduled to start in under an hour. We'll bring you live updates, scores, and analysis from that exciting contest. Until next time, cheers and thanks for being part of our cricket coverage!

The skipper of Bangladesh Sumaiya Akter says they are delighted with the win and are looking forward to the positives. Adds that the team is full of young talents who'll surely represent the national side going ahead and a tournament as such gives them the perfect platform to have a feel of what it takes to play for the national side.

The skipper of West Indies Women Under-19, Samara Ramnath says it is not the best way to end the tournament but credit to Bangladesh Women Under-19 as they played better. Mentions that they lacked the attitude and mindset but they will keep their head high and look to improve.
... TIME FOR THE PRESENTATIONS ...

Nishika IS THE PLAYER OF THE MATCH. Nishika is up for a chat and she says she tries her best for the country and feels that she could have done even better. Mentions the skipper believes n her and gives her the responsibility to bowl in the Powerplay and she tries to do her best.

Bangladesh Women Under-19 came out to bat with intent and their opening pair of Fahomida Choya who scored 14 off 25 and Juairiya Ferdous with her 25 off 28 was a treat to watch. The West Indies Women Under-19 bowlers had no answers to their batting and in that pressure, they ended up giving 14 extras making it easier for the Bangladesh Women Under-19 batters. In the end, Bangladesh finish their World Cup affairs on a high by chasing down 55 runs in 8.5 overs without losing a wicket.

The day started on a delay and a 13-over affair started with Bangladesh Women Under-19 putting West Indies Women Under-19 to bat first. The Indies' top 3 were taken away in no time by the young off-break Nishita Akter Nishi. It was then a slow-paced West Indies Women Under-19 innings that took them to 54 with the loss of 6 wickets in their 13 overs. Bangladesh Women Under-19 were brilliant on the field and their efforts in the field cut down 10 runs for their bowlers.

Fahomida Choya and Juairiya Ferdous finish things in style as Bangladesh Women Under-19 crush the West Indies Women Under-19 with a 10-wicket victory by chasing down 55 runs in 8.5 overs in a rain-reduced 13 over per side game. Brilliant performance by Bangladesh, first with the ball and in the field and then with the bat. It is the first time that Bangladesh Women Under-19 have registered a 10-wicket win in ICC U19 T20 World Cups.
FOUR! That's the winning runs. Short of a length around middle and off, Juairiya Ferdous cuts this past cover-point to her right for a boundary. Bangladesh Women Under-19 wins this by 10 wickets.
